subject.title: fix(plugins): run message_sending on all channel agent-reply deliveries (#92374)

question: Should this PR remain the canonical fix for the outbound `message_sending` bypass after the suffix re-entry bug is repaired, or should maintainers split the dispatcher repair from the Telegram streamed-final safety boundary?
rationale: The patch changes a documented pre-send safety hook boundary and adds an internal delivery-owned opt-out, so code review can identify the defect but cannot approve the permanent hook ownership policy alone.

options.title: Repair and keep this branch canonical
options.body: Fix suffix delivery to avoid re-running `message_sending`, rebase, refresh Telegram proof, and use this PR as the broad fix for the linked canonical issue.

options.title: Land a narrower dispatcher fix first
options.body: Choose a smaller dispatcher-only PR and keep Telegram streamed-final exactly-once gating tracked separately.

options.title: Pause for a unified outbound boundary
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose a broader unbypassable outbound policy architecture.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep this branch canonical
recommendation.body: Fix suffix delivery to avoid re-running `message_sending`, rebase, refresh Telegram proof, and use this PR as the broad fix for the linked canonical issue.
